display.purpose: The hero headline only; Libre Caslon Display in spaced uppercase.

headline.purpose: Section headings that follow the opening hairline rule; same face and caps as display, one step down.

title.purpose: Team plate names and, at fixed sizes, the footer wordmark (1.5rem), Stars tier names (1.25rem) and the small-screen menu (1.5rem).

atlas-label.purpose: The chart's own voice: house names under a team title, 'Tab. N' plate captions, roman numerals, star names and ring labels (11 to 12px in SVG). Never used for UI controls.

quote.purpose: The founder's words on the plate; Libre Caslon Text upright at reading size.

body.purpose: Hanken Grotesk with tabular figures; leads and facts in lavender on the sky, plate-ink at 80% on the plate.

label.purpose: Every UI control and metadata slug: buttons, nav links, roles, games, legends, and the date column of every fixture. Uppercase, 0.18em tracking, medium weight.

hairlines.name: hairline
hairlines.purpose: Every edge on the sky: rules, row tops, pill borders.

hairlines.name: hairline-ink
hairlines.purpose: A stronger ink edge; defined for emphasis, used sparingly.

hairlines.name: hairline-plate
hairlines.purpose: Every edge on the cream plate.

hairlines.name: constellation-edge
hairlines.value: stroke #ede9f5; stroke-width 1.4; stroke-dasharray 1.5 3.5; stroke-linecap round; opacity 0.8 (on plate: stroke #6f3fa5, opacity 0.5)
hairlines.purpose: Dotted edges joining stars in a figure.

hairlines.name: star-leader
hairlines.purpose: The line from a named star out to its italic label.

hairlines.name: calendar-rail
hairlines.value: border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, #c9b3e8 22%, transparent); padding-left 32px; 11px starlight star at -2.35rem on each new day
hairlines.purpose: The vertical rail the calendar timeline hangs from.

shadows.name: ink-glow
shadows.purpose: The hero's primary button only; a soft ink pool under the one action in the first viewport. No other element casts a shadow.

surfaces.name: nav-ground
surfaces.value: color-mix(in oklab, #0b0716 92%, transparent); clip-path: ellipse(115% 100% at 50% 0%)
surfaces.purpose: The ecliptic: the header's ground, bowed across the width, no backdrop-filter.

surfaces.name: menu-ground
surfaces.purpose: The small-screen menu panel under the ecliptic.

surfaces.name: hero-void
surfaces.purpose: The pool of void under the point cloud, dissolving into the sky at the edges; a 160px linear fade to the sky closes the hero at its foot.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only authored easing; used by the rule-draw entrance.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: transform scaleX(0) to scaleX(1); 900ms ease-out-expo; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 0% entry 30%; transform-origin left center
motion.purpose: The first section's opening hairline draws in from the left as it enters the viewport. Used on that rule only; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour shifts on links, pills and rows.

motion.name: label-dim
motion.purpose: Unlit constellation labels fall to 45% while one star is active.

motion.name: canvas-reveal
motion.purpose: The hero canvas fades in once the starfield is ready.

motion.name: hero-pin
motion.value: section 175svh; sticky viewport 100svh; headline opacity 1 - min(1, p / 0.55); copy translateY(p * -24px); legend opacity max((p - 0.5) / 0.4, 1 - p * 2.5); starfield morph = p
motion.purpose: The scroll-pinned morph from monogram to the ring of twelve; the headline yields to the legend as the cloud re-forms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: scroll-behavior auto; rule-draw none; starfield renders one still frame and ignores the pointer

focus.value: outline: 2px solid #c9b3e8; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px (on the plate the outline is #6f3fa5)

narrative.overview:
The site is a star atlas in the lineage of Flamsteed and Bode: a night sky of near-black violet on which the org is charted rather than displayed. Every team is its animal's constellation, sampled from the real team mark and joined by dotted edges; every player is a named star on that figure; the twelve houses of the zodiac sit on one hairline ring, thirty degrees apart with the Tiger at the top, and that ring is the single geometry the hero morphs into and the sections are composed around. Dense reading (the founder's words, the staff, the Stars program) inverts to a cream engraved plate with the same hairline grammar, the way an atlas turns from chart to commentary.

The material vocabulary is small and used everywhere: 1px hairlines at low opacity for every edge, four-point star glyphs as the only marker, roman numerals for plates and tiers, spaced Caslon capitals for anything that names a thing, italic Caslon for the chart's own labels, and Hanken Grotesk with tabular figures for facts and controls. There are no cards, no filled panels, no shadows beyond one ink glow under the hero's action, and no UI icon set; the only glyphs besides the star are brand marks on social links. Depth comes from tonal grounds (void pool, sky, plate) and from opacity, never from elevation.

The build is Tailwind v4 (@theme tokens in web/src/app/globals.css) with fonts loaded through next/font; the hero and plate figures are vgpu (WebGPU) point clouds with still-image fallbacks. The risk named in the direction contract holds: the world must stay a committed atlas and never drift into generic dark-mode space.
keyCharacteristics: Night-sky ground (`sky`) with a pool of true black only under the hero cloud; cream plate for Read surfaces.
One accent (ink purple) used as fill for the single primary action and as the colour of the star marker; text on the sky is starlight and lavender, never ink.
Three type voices: spaced Caslon Display caps, italic Caslon Text atlas labels, Hanken Grotesk UI with tabular figures.
Hairlines, dotted constellation edges and four-point stars are the whole material kit; no cards, no shadows, no UI icon set (brand marks appear only on social links).
The ring of twelve is the one geometry: hero morph target, section diagram, and the order the plates are numbered in.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every edge is 1px at low opacity, mixed from the surface's own secondary: lavender at 22% on the sky, plate-ink at 22% on the plate, ink at 45% when an edge must read stronger. No edge is ever a solid colour at full strength.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: Ink fills exactly one pill per viewport. Its companion action is a hairline pill; every other link is text that rises from lavender to starlight.

rules.name: The Real Tier Rule
rules.body: Bronze, silver, gold and diamond appear only beside a tier that exists in the Stars program. They are never decoration or state colours.

rules.name: The Sky, Not Space Rule
rules.body: The ground is the violet sky, never neutral black or grey. True black exists only as the pool beneath the hero cloud, and it fades back into the sky before the page begins.

rules.name: The Spaced Caps Rule
rules.body: Caslon Display is only ever set uppercase at 0.08em tracking with 1.02 leading. It is never set in mixed case and never below 1.25rem.

rules.name: The Atlas Voice Rule
rules.body: Italic Caslon Text is the chart's annotation, not the UI's. It names houses, plates, stars and numerals and sits beneath or beside the thing it names; it never labels a control and is never used as an eyebrow above a heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number on the site is a tabular figure (tnum is on at the body). Season numbers, player counts and dates align.

rules.name: The Rule-First Rule
rules.body: A section begins with a hairline, not a heading. The heading follows 32px beneath it.

rules.name: The One Geometry Rule
rules.body: New arrangements of the teams derive from the ring: twelve positions, thirty degrees apart, Tiger at the top, counter-clockwise, flagship at the centre. Do not lay the houses out on a grid.

rules.name: The Flat Sky Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow except the hero's primary action. Lift is expressed as a brighter hairline, a lit star, or a colour rising toward starlight.

rules.name: The Pill-or-Square Rule
rules.body: No intermediate radii. A thing is either a full pill (actions, avatars, dots) or a hairlined rectangle (rows, rules, sections).

dos: Do open every section with a hairline rule and set the headline 32px beneath it in Caslon Display caps at 0.08em.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines mixed from the surface's secondary (lavender 22% on sky, plate-ink 22% on plate) and stack rows with 1px gaps.
Do use the four-point star glyph (8 to 10px, ink on sky, starlight on the hero legend) as the marker for any list or star-led link.
Do put one ink pill per viewport and pair it with a hairline pill; let every other link be text rising from lavender to starlight.
Do write the chart's own labels (house names, "Tab. N", numerals, star names) in italic Caslon Text, placed beneath or beside what they name.
Do invert dense reading to the cream plate and keep the hairline grammar, ink links and display caps intact there.
Do derive any arrangement of the teams from the ring: twelve positions, thirty degrees apart, Tiger at the top, flagship at the centre.
Do keep numbers tabular and roman numerals for plates and tiers.
Do set dated rows with a caps date column (6.5rem on the calendar rail, 3.25rem on a plate) and mark each new day on a rail with a starlight star.
Do honour reduced motion: still starfield, no rule-draw, no smooth scroll.
donts: Don't introduce cards, filled panels, or intermediate corner radii; the only shapes are the pill and the hairlined rectangle.
Don't cast shadows; the hero's ink glow is the single exception and does not travel.
Don't blur the nav or any fixed surface over the canvas; use the clipped sky ground.
Don't set ink as text on the sky, or set Caslon Display in mixed case or below 1.25rem.
Don't add a UI icon set; the star glyph, the dotted edge and the hairline are the kit, and brand marks appear only on social links at 12 to 14px in currentColor.
Don't use the tier colours or the four team-logo colours outside a real tier or the hero ring.
Don't ground a surface on neutral black or grey; the sky is violet, and true black belongs only to the hero pool.
Don't place an eyebrow or kicker above a heading; the house line lives under the team title.
